hero.title: Events
hero.paragraph: We create live content events, from festivals to long, medium and short-form productions in more than 30 countries.

club-media-fest.title: Club Media Fest
club-media-fest.description: The first international festival showcasing youtubers/influencers. More than 30 artists on stage. 2 stages. Music sets, DJ sets, challenges, panels, meet & greet, fashion shows, comedy, beauty.

cruce-de-campeones.title: Cruce de Campeones
cruce-de-campeones.description: Cruce de Campeones brings together the leading figures of Spanish-language Freestyle in an event where artists compete to reach a grand final and be crowned champion.

personal-fest.title: Personal Fest
personal-fest.description: Personal Fest was one of the most important music festivals in Argentina, held mainly in Buenos Aires. Organized by the telecom company Personal, it stood out for bringing together top-tier international artists (rock, pop, electronic) with local bands across multiple stages.

copa-goals.title: Copa Goals
copa-goals.description: "Goals" is an event tied to amateur gaming, in which thousands of kids had the chance to play to fulfill a dream: to play alongside their idols on the day of the event.

comic-con.title: Comic Con
comic-con.description: Comic Con is the leading pop culture convention, bringing together fans of comics, anime, film, video games and cosplay in a unique space.

unkla-cup.title: Unkla Cup — Team Gamers
unkla-cup.description: UNKLA Cup / Team Gamers. Planning, Development and Execution of a Gaming Tournament.

clinica-cocina-victor-moreno-movistar-ve.title: Cooking clinic with Victor Moreno — Movistar Venezuela
clinica-cocina-victor-moreno-movistar-ve.description: Service users took part in an exclusive trivia game to earn points and win their spot in an exclusive cooking clinic led by Victor Moreno.

team-gamers-movistar-venezuela.title: FitelVen stand and activation — Team Gamers Movistar Venezuela
team-gamers-movistar-venezuela.shortTitle:
FITELVEN STAND AND ACTIVATION
TEAM GAMERS
team-gamers-movistar-venezuela.description: A stand was set up to promote the Team Gamers product. The two main actions were the creation of a totem featuring a trivia game for participants to win prizes, and the screening of a clinic.

benja-torres-personal-paraguay.title: Activation at a shopping mall with Benja Torres — Personal Paraguay
benja-torres-personal-paraguay.shortTitle:
ACTIVATION AT A SHOPPING MALL
WITH BENJA TORRES
benja-torres-personal-paraguay.description: An unexpected and disruptive artistic intervention in which Benja Torres becomes the epicenter of an emotional experience inside the shopping mall. Through his lyrics and his art, the event humanized the associated brands, building a close bond with the audience.
